title: Attributes, properties, classes, styles
learningObjectives: Explain attributes, properties, classes, styles and update browser documents with safe DOM and event patterns.

understand.concept: DOM elements expose attributes and properties. Attributes are values in markup; properties are JavaScript object members reflecting current element state. classList provides add, remove, toggle, and contains methods. Inline styles can be changed through the style property, while classes are often better for reusable presentation.
understand.whyItMatters: Understanding attribute/property differences helps manage form state and avoid inconsistent UI. Prefer class-based styling for reusable visual states and use appropriate DOM properties for live values.
understand.analogy: Attributes are written labels on the element; properties are the live values exposed by the browser object.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; actual DOM, event, and security behaviour follows browser platform rules.
